place: Xirivella (Horta Sud), roundabout on the Carretera de Torrent
description: Brown floodwater covers a roundabout junction. description: 17 s portrait clip filmed from a balcony: fast brown floodwater runs down a street between a walled embankment and parked cars while several cars drive and stall in it.
